{"code": "import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_csv('data/penguins.csv')

# Compute mean flipper length per species, dropping missing values
mean_flipper_by_species = df.groupby('species', as_index=False)['flipper_length_mm'].mean()

# Print the full result to capture exact values
print(mean_flipper_by_species)

# Find and print the species with the highest mean
highest_mean_species = mean_flipper_by_species.loc[mean_flipper_by_species['flipper_length_mm'].idxmax()]['species']
print(f'Highest mean flipper length species: {highest_mean_species}')"}
